headline: An engineer at the intersection of medicine and code.
bio:
Since 2017 I have been building software that doctors and patients actually use: Bluetooth hardware detection, online consultations, imaging viewers and MDT collaboration, covering the full mobile delivery chain from auth, messaging and APNs push to audio/video calls, realtime WebSocket collaboration and App Store releases.
On the medical imaging side I work across DICOM retrieval, report viewing, prior-study comparison and MPR / 3D / AI analysis workflows — from the web viewer and iOS client all the way to Go / React full-stack services. In the last two years I have folded Claude Code, Cursor, AI agents and a personal knowledge base into my daily engineering loop.
philosophy: “Tools for doctors should be fast, honest and quiet. Speed earns trust; honesty about uncertainty keeps it.”

experience.description: Own the medical imaging viewer and realtime collaboration backend, across web viewer, iOS client and Go services.
Shipped core modules of online consultation, clinician assistant and MDT collaboration apps.
Started with a Bluetooth formaldehyde-detection app, wiring hardware, BLE transport and data parsing to the mobile UI.
